title: relay_error: SmtpRelayError public enum missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: SmtpRelayError is a pub enum re-exported from stoa-smtp (pub use relay_error::SmtpRelayError in lib.rs). Adding a new variant (e.g. RateLimited) is a breaking change without #[non_exhaustive]. The all_variants_classified test uses a Vec, not an exhaustive match, so it stays valid after adding #[non_exhaustive]. Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to the enum definition.
